intro: Liberia exports iron ore, rubber and gold and has one of the world's largest ship registries.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Firestone has run a huge rubber plantation since 1926. Many of the world's ships fly the Liberian flag for registration.

chapters.title: Rebuilding
text: Roads, power and schools are still being rebuilt after the war.

keyTerms.meaning: Registering a ship in another country for lower costs.

cardGroups.title: Made in Liberia
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Liberia makes and sells to the world.
